caption:
Your lead has a clock on it, and most shops don't realize it's running.

Here's how a lead's value decays hour by hour, and what to do in each window instead of treating every lead the same.

Leads contacted within 5 minutes convert at a meaningfully higher rate than leads contacted even an hour later. Every hour past that, the odds keep dropping.

Build your follow-up sequence to match the clock.
